examples.chinese: 台灣的夜市很有特色，除了有各式各樣的小吃，還有不少好玩的遊戲。
examples.pinyin: Táiwān de yèshì hěn yǒu tèsè, chúle yǒu gèshìgèyàng de xiǎochī, hái yǒu bùshǎo hǎowán de yóuxì.
examples.english: Taiwan's night markets are very distinctive; besides having various snacks, there are also quite a few fun games.

examples.chinese: 台灣有各式各樣的小吃，其中最吸引我的是蚵仔煎。
examples.pinyin: Táiwān yǒu gèshìgèyàng de xiǎochī, qízhōng zuì xīyǐn wǒ de shì kēzǎijiān.
examples.english: Taiwan has all kinds of snacks, among which the one that attracts me most is oyster omelet.

examples.chinese: 公司進了各式各樣的健身機器， 我們得好好利用這些機器，訓練自己的體力。美美剛進模特兒公司時，有一位導演找她演戲，沒想到就讓她變成了有名的明星。
examples.pinyin: Gōngsī jìn le gèshì-gèyàng de jiànshēn jīqì, wǒmen děi hǎohǎo lìyòng zhèxiē jīqì, xùnliàn zìjǐ de tǐlì. Měiměi gāng jìn mótè'ér gōngsī shí, yǒu yí wèi dǎoyǎn zhǎo tā yǎn xì, méi xiǎngdào jiù ràng tā biàn chéng le yǒumíng de míngxīng.
examples.english: The company purchased various kinds of fitness machines; we must make good use of these machines to train our physical strength. When Meimei first entered the modeling agency, a director asked her to act in a show; unexpectedly, it made her a famous star.

examples.chinese: 臺灣南部不僅天氣好、旅遊景點多，還有各式各樣的傳統小吃，很值得去走走。
examples.pinyin: Táiwān nánbù bùjǐn tiānqì hǎo, lǚyóu jǐngdiǎn duō, hái yǒu gè shì gè yàng de chuántǒng xiǎochī, hěn zhídé qù zǒuzǒu.
examples.english: Southern Taiwan not only has good weather and many touring spots, but also has all kinds of traditional snacks; it's well worth a visit.

examples.chinese: 現代各式各樣的科技產品，讓人們的生活更舒適、便利。這家旅館每個房間都設計得很現代，吸引不少年輕人來訂房。
examples.pinyin: Xiàndài gè shì gè yàng de kējì chǎnpǐn, ràng rénmen de shēnghuó gèng shūshì, biànlì. Zhè jiā lǚguǎn měi gè fángjiān dōu shèjì de hěn xiàndài, xīyǐn bù shǎo niánqīngrén lái dìng fáng.
examples.english: Modern various technological products make people's lives more comfortable and convenient. This hotel's rooms are all designed in a very modern way, attracting many young people to book rooms.

examples.chinese: 網路商店滿足了人們購物的需求，就是不出門，也可買到各式各樣的生活用品。
examples.pinyin: Wǎnglù shāngdiàn mǎnzú le rénmen gòuwù de xūqiú, jiùshì bù chūmén, yě kě mǎi dào gè shì gè yàng de shēnghuó yòngpǐn.
examples.english: Online stores have satisfied people's shopping needs; even without leaving home, you can buy all kinds of daily necessities.

examples.chinese: 快時尚的概念，就是在短時間內提供各式各樣的流行商品，讓顧客有更多更好的選擇。
examples.pinyin: Kuài shíshàng de gàiniàn, jiùshì zài duǎn shíjiān nèi tígōng gè shì gè yàng de liúxíng shāngpǐn, ràng gùkè yǒu gèng duō gèng hǎo de xuǎnzé.
examples.english: The concept of fast fashion is to provide a variety of trendy products in a short time, giving customers more and better choices.

examples.chinese: 元宵節時公園裡點起各式各樣的燈籠，各種顏色的燈光漂亮極了。
examples.pinyin: Yuánxiāojié shí gōngyuán lǐ diǎn qǐ gè shì gè yàng de dēnglóng, gè zhǒng yánsè de dēngguāng piàoliang jí le.
examples.english: During the Lantern Festival, various lanterns are lit in the park; the lights of all colors are extremely beautiful.

examples.chinese: 他迷上足球，所以買了各式各樣的足球鞋。
examples.pinyin: Tā mí shàng zúqiú, suǒyǐ mǎi le gè shì gè yàng de zúqiú xié.
examples.english: He is fascinated by soccer, so he bought all kinds of soccer shoes.

examples.chinese: 這條街道旁有各式各樣的商店與餐廳，假日時相當熱鬧。
examples.pinyin: Zhè tiáo jiēdào páng yǒu gèshìgèyàng de shāngdiàn yǔ cāntīng, jiàrì shí xiāngdāng rènao.
examples.english: Along this street there are all kinds of shops and restaurants; on holidays it is quite bustling.

examples.chinese: 個人在使用各式各樣的網路服務時，也應該注意隱私問題。
examples.pinyin: Gèrén zài shǐyòng gè shì gè yàng de wǎnglù fúwù shí, yě yīnggāi zhùyì yǐnsī wèntí.
examples.english: When individuals use various kinds of internet services, they should also pay attention to privacy issues.

examples.chinese: 企業為了錄用合適的人才，而採用各式各樣的方式。
examples.pinyin: Qǐyè wèile lùyòng héshì de réncái, ér cǎiyòng gè shì gè yàng de fāngshì.
examples.english: Enterprises adopt various methods in order to hire suitable talent.

examples.chinese: 學校餐廳提供各式各樣的營養食品，供學生挑選。
examples.pinyin: Xuéxiào cāntīng tígōng gè shì gè yàng de yíngyǎng shípǐn, gōng xuéshēng tiāoxuǎn.
examples.english: The school cafeteria provides a variety of nutritious foods for students to choose from.

examples.chinese: 那家印尼餐廳常常客滿，你最好先打電話訂位。
examples.pinyin: Nà jiā Yìnní cāntīng chángcháng kèmǎn, nǐ zuìhǎo xiān dǎ diànhuà dìngwèi.
examples.english: That Indonesian restaurant is often full; you'd better call ahead to make a reservation.

examples.chinese: 參加團體旅遊比較不自由，可是不必自己訂旅館、訂車票。
examples.pinyin: Cānjiā tuántǐ lǚyóu bǐjiào bù zìyóu, kěshì bùbì zìjǐ dìng lǚguǎn, dìng chēpiào.
examples.english: Joining a group tour is less free, but you don't have to book hotels and tickets yourself.

examples.chinese: 那家動物餐廳的空間很大，可以讓客人的小動物自由自在地活動。
examples.pinyin: Nà jiā dòngwù cāntīng de kōngjiān hěn dà, kěyǐ ràng kèrén de xiǎo dòngwù zìyóuzìzài de huódòng.
examples.english: That animal restaurant has a lot of space, allowing guests' small pets to move around freely and fancy-free.

examples.chinese: 跟團體旅遊比起來，我覺得一個人的旅行自由得多，也能訓練自己解決問題的能力。
examples.pinyin: Gēn tuántǐ lǚyóu bǐ qǐlái, wǒ juéde yí ge rén de lǚxíng zìyóu de duō, yě néng xùnliàn zìjǐ jiějué wèntí de nénglì.
examples.english: Compared with group travel, I think traveling alone is much freer, and it can also train your ability to solve problems on your own.

examples.chinese: 人人都渴望浪漫的愛情和幸福的家庭，不過自由自在的單身生活也是不錯的。
examples.pinyin: Rénrén dōu kěwàng làngmàn de àiqíng hé xìngfú de jiātíng, búguò zìyóuzìzài de dānshēn shēnghuó yě shì búcuò de.
examples.english: Everyone longs for romantic love and a happy family, but a free and easy single life is also not bad.

examples.chinese: 一個政府如果事事控制人民，沒有給人民自由，就不是個理想的政府。
examples.pinyin: Yī gè zhèngfǔ rúguǒ shìshì kòngzhì rénmín, méiyǒu gěi rénmín zìyóu, jiù bù shì gè lǐxiǎng de zhèngfǔ.
examples.english: If a government controls the people in everything and does not give the people freedom, it is not an ideal government.

examples.chinese: 在自由戀愛的時代中，還是有人透過相親的方式來認識另一半。
examples.pinyin: Zài zìyóu liàn'ài de shídài zhōng, háishì yǒu rén tòuguò xiāngqīn de fāngshì lái rènshi lìng yībàn.
examples.english: In this era of free love, there are still people who get to know their other half through blind dates.

examples.chinese: 跟那位學者談話是種享受，能夠自由又自在地交換想法。
examples.pinyin: Gēn nà wèi xuézhě tánhuà shì zhǒng xiǎngshòu, nénggòu zìyóu yòu zìzài de jiāohuàn xiǎngfǎ.
examples.english: Talking with that scholar is a kind of enjoyment—being able to exchange ideas freely and comfortably.

examples.chinese: 在自由國家，只要人民覺得不合理，都能跟相關部門抗議。
examples.pinyin: Zài zìyóu guójiā, zhǐyào rénmín juéde bù hélǐ, dōu néng gēn xiāngguān bùmén kàngyì.
examples.english: In a free country, as long as people feel something is unreasonable, they can protest to the relevant departments.

examples.chinese: 這座圓形廣場是為了紀念自由而建的。
examples.pinyin: Zhè zuò yuánxíng guǎngchǎng shì wèile jìniàn zìyóu ér jiàn de.
examples.english: This circular plaza was built to commemorate freedom.

examples.chinese: 爺爺現在每天早睡早起，不但精神好了，身體也變健康了。
examples.pinyin: Yéye xiànzài měitiān zǎo shuì zǎo qǐ, bùdàn jīngshén hǎo le, shēntǐ yě biàn jiànkāng le.
examples.english: Grandpa now goes to bed early and gets up early every day. Not only is his spirit better, but his health has also become better.

examples.chinese: 早上開車去上班時，忽然有隻狗從路口跑出來，把我嚇了一跳。
examples.pinyin: Zǎoshang kāichē qù shàngbān shí, hūrán yǒu zhī gǒu cóng lùkǒu pǎo chūlái, bǎ wǒ xià le yí tiào.
examples.english: When I was driving to work this morning, a dog suddenly ran out from the intersection and gave me a shock.

examples.chinese: 小韓早晚都打工，是因為想多存一些錢，早一點完成出國念書的夢想。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎo Hán zǎowǎn dōu dǎgōng, shì yīnwèi xiǎng duō cún yìxiē qián, zǎo yìdiǎn wánchéng chūguó niànshū de mèngxiǎng.
examples.english: Xiao Han works part-time in the morning and evening because he wants to save more money and fulfill his dream of studying abroad earlier.

examples.chinese: 為了家人的健康，媽媽每天都早起準備營養豐富的早餐，讓我們一天的開始就很有精神。
examples.pinyin: Wèile jiārén de jiànkāng, māma měitiān dōu zǎoqǐ zhǔnbèi yíngyǎng fēngfù de zǎocān, ràng wǒmen yì tiān de kāishǐ jiù hěn yǒu jīngshén.
examples.english: For the family's health, Mom gets up early every day to prepare a nutritious breakfast, so that we start the day full of energy.

examples.chinese: 我每天上學以前，一定先在家吃早飯。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ měitiān shàngxué yǐqián, yídìng xiān zài jiā chī zǎofàn.
examples.english: Every day before I go to school, I always eat breakfast at home first.

examples.chinese: 爸爸每天早上一起床就看報紙。
examples.pinyin: Bàba měitiān zǎoshang yì qǐchuáng jiù kàn bàozhǐ.
examples.english: Every morning as soon as Dad gets out of bed, he reads the newspaper.

examples.chinese: 我每個星期天早上都跟家人去教堂。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ měi ge xīngqītiān zǎoshang dōu gēn jiārén qù jiàotáng.
examples.english: Every Sunday morning I go to church with my family.

examples.chinese: 每天早上公園裡都有很多人在運動，非常熱鬧。
examples.pinyin: Měitiān zǎoshang gōngyuán lǐ dōu yǒu hěn duō rén zài yùndòng, fēicháng rènao.
examples.english: Every morning in the park there are many people exercising, it is very lively.

examples.chinese: 現在十點了，不早了，我想回家了。
examples.pinyin: Xiànzài shí diǎn le, bù zǎo le, wǒ xiǎng huí jiā le.
examples.english: It's ten o'clock now; it's not early anymore, I want to go home.

examples.chinese: 我明天早上十點會在學校門口等你。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ míngtiān zǎoshang shí diǎn huì zài xuéxiào ménkǒu děng nǐ.
examples.english: I will wait for you at the school gate at ten o'clock tomorrow morning.

examples.chinese: 他每天早上去上班，晚上去上課，真辛苦！
examples.pinyin: Tā měi tiān zǎoshang qù shàngbān, wǎnshang qù shàngkè, zhēn xīnkǔ!
examples.english: He goes to work every morning and goes to class in the evening; it's really tough!

examples.chinese: 我去上課以前，一定會先在家吃早飯。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ qù shàngkè yǐqián, yídìng huì xiān zài jiā chī zǎofàn.
examples.english: Before I go to class, I definitely will first eat breakfast at home.

examples.chinese: 學校的圖書館早上八點開，晚上九點關。
examples.pinyin: Xuéxiào de túshūguǎn zǎoshang bā diǎn kāi, wǎnshang jiǔ diǎn guān.
examples.english: The school library opens at 8 a.m. and closes at 9 p.m.

examples.chinese: 我明天早上九點要到機場。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ míngtiān zǎoshang jiǔ diǎn yào dào jīchǎng.
examples.english: I need to arrive at the airport at nine o'clock tomorrow morning.

examples.chinese: 我每天早上八點半到學校。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ měitiān zǎoshang bā diǎn bàn dào xuéxiào.
examples.english: I arrive at school at 8:30 every morning.

examples.chinese: 我平常早上七點起床，八點吃早飯。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ píngcháng zǎoshang qī diǎn qǐchuáng, bā diǎn chī zǎofàn.
examples.english: I usually get up at seven and have breakfast at eight in the morning.

examples.chinese: 我每天早上七點去學校運動。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ měi tiān zǎoshang qī diǎn qù xuéxiào yùndòng.
examples.english: I go to school to exercise at 7:00 every morning.

examples.chinese: 我爸爸每天早上都喝一杯咖啡。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ bàba měi tiān zǎoshang dōu hē yì bēi kāfēi.
examples.english: My father drinks a cup of coffee every morning.

examples.chinese: A：你今天早上有課嗎？ B：我今天早上沒有課。
examples.pinyin: A: Nǐ jīntiān zǎoshang yǒu kè ma? B: Wǒ jīntiān zǎoshang méi yǒu kè.
examples.english: A: Do you have class this morning? B: I don’t have class this morning.

examples.chinese: B:我今天早上沒有課？ A:你今天早上有課嗎？
examples.pinyin: B: Wǒ jīntiān zǎoshang méiyǒu kè? A: Nǐ jīntiān zǎoshang yǒu kè ma?
examples.english: B: I don't have class this morning? A: Do you have class this morning?

examples.chinese: 我早上沒有課，九點去圖書館。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ zǎoshang méi yǒu kè, jiǔ diǎn qù túshūguǎn.
examples.english: I don’t have class in the morning. I am going to the library at 9:00.

examples.chinese: 張先生常幫太太買菜、洗衣服， 要是比太太早下班，還會把晚餐做好，真體貼。我同學很體貼父母，經常煮飯、 做家事，幫了父母不少忙。
examples.pinyin: Zhāng xiānsheng cháng bāng tàitai mǎi cài, xǐ yīfu, yàoshi bǐ tàitai zǎo xiàbān, hái huì bǎ wǎncān zuò hǎo, zhēn tǐtiē. Wǒ tóngxué hěn tǐtiē fùmǔ, jīngcháng zhǔfàn, zuò jiāshì, bāng le fùmǔ bùshǎo máng.
examples.english: Mr. Zhang often helps his wife buy groceries and wash clothes; if he gets off work earlier than his wife, he also makes dinner—he is truly considerate. My classmate is very considerate of his parents; he often cooks and does housework, helping his parents a lot.

examples.chinese: 我去參加朋友的婚禮，除了送紅包，還祝福他們事事如意、早生貴子、永遠幸福。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ qù cānjiā péngyou de hūnlǐ, chúle sòng hóngbāo, hái zhùfú tāmen shìshì rúyì, zǎo shēng guìzǐ, yǒngyuǎn xìngfú.
examples.english: I went to attend a friend's wedding; besides giving a red envelope, I also wished them that everything goes as they wish, that they soon have a child, and that they be happy forever.

examples.chinese: 這次的電腦展集合了各國有名的牌子，很值得參觀。老師要帶我們去參觀博物館，明天早上九點在校門口集合。
examples.pinyin: 1. Zhè cì de diànnǎo zhǎn jíhé le gè guó yǒumíng de páizi, hěn zhídé cānguān. 2. Lǎoshī yào dài wǒmen qù cānguān bówùguǎn, míngtiān zǎoshang jiǔ diǎn zài xiàoménkǒu jíhé.
examples.english: 1. This computer exhibition gathered famous brands from various countries and is well worth visiting. 2. The teacher is taking us to visit the museum; we will gather at the school gate at 9 a.m. tomorrow.

examples.chinese: 只有集合大家的力量，有錢出錢、有力出力，才能幫助災民早一點恢復正常生活。
examples.pinyin: Zhǐyǒu jíhé dàjiā de lìliàng, yǒu qián chū qián, yǒu lì chū lì, cái néng bāngzhù zāimín zǎo yìdiǎn huīfù zhèngcháng shēnghuó.
examples.english: Only by gathering everyone's strength—those with money contributing money, those with strength contributing strength—can we help the disaster victims return to normal life sooner.

examples.chinese: 我家在大馬路旁，從早到晚噪音不斷，嚴重影響了生活品質，所以決定搬家。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ jiā zài dà mǎlù páng, cóng zǎo dào wǎn zàoyīn bùduàn, yánzhòng yǐngxiǎng le shēnghuó pǐnzhí, suǒyǐ juédìng bānjiā.
examples.english: My home is next to a major road, and there is constant noise from morning till night, which has seriously affected our quality of life, so we decided to move.

examples.chinese: 媽媽今天要加班，我得照顧妹妹，不能不早一點兒回家。
examples.pinyin: Māma jīntiān yào jiābān, wǒ děi zhàogù mèimei, bùnéngbù zǎo yīdiǎnr huí jiā.
examples.english: Mom has to work overtime today, and I have to take care of my little sister, so I cannot but go home a bit earlier.

examples.chinese: 秋天的天氣變化很大，早晚都有點涼，出門時最好帶件外套。 這碗魚湯要趁熱喝，涼了就不好喝了。
examples.pinyin: Qiūtiān de tiānqì biànhuà hěn dà, zǎowǎn dōu yǒudiǎn liáng, chūmén shí zuìhǎo dài jiàn wàitào. Zhè wǎn yútāng yào chèn rè hē, liáng le jiù bù hǎohē le.
examples.english: Autumn weather changes a lot; it's a bit chilly morning and evening, so it's best to bring a jacket when going out. This bowl of fish soup should be drunk while hot; once it's cold, it won't taste good.

examples.chinese: 氣象預報人員確定明天颱風會來，我們最好去吃超市買一些泡麵、雞蛋。老闆要我照確定的日期去南部出差，如果有什麼改變，他會早點兒通知我。
examples.pinyin: Qìxiàng yùbào rényuán quèdìng míngtiān táifēng huì lái, wǒmen zuìhǎo qù chāoshì mǎi yìxiē pàomiàn, jīdàn. Lǎobǎn yào wǒ zhào quèdìng de rìqī qù nánbù chūchāi, rúguǒ yǒu shénme gǎibiàn, tā huì zǎodiǎnr tōngzhī wǒ.
examples.english: The weather forecasters are sure that the typhoon will come tomorrow; we'd better go to the supermarket to buy some instant noodles and eggs. The boss wants me to go on a business trip to the south according to the confirmed date; if there are any changes, he will notify me earlier.

examples.chinese: 我跟弟弟是雙胞胎，很多人都以為我是他，這樣的誤會我早就習慣了。A:何小姐只是我的鄰居，不是我的女朋友，大家都誤會了。 B:你對她很體貼，不但常送她上班，還常陪她逛街，大家對你們有誤會也是正常的。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ gēn dìdi shì shuāngbāotāi, hěn duō rén dōu yǐwéi wǒ shì tā, zhèyàng de wùhuì wǒ zǎo jiù xíguàn le. A: Hé xiǎojiě zhǐshì wǒ de línjū, bùshì wǒ de nǚpéngyǒu, dàjiā dōu wùhuì le. B: Nǐ duì tā hěn tǐtiē, bùdàn cháng sòng tā shàngbān, hái cháng péi tā guàngjiē, dàjiā duì nǐmen yǒu wùhuì yě shì zhèngcháng de.
examples.english: My younger brother and I are twins; many people think I am him, and I've long been used to this kind of misunderstanding. A: Miss He is just my neighbor, not my girlfriend; everyone has misunderstood. B: You are very considerate to her; not only do you often take her to work, but you also often accompany her shopping. It's normal for everyone to have a misunderstanding about you two.

examples.chinese: 小高希望能早日退休，回鄉下照顧年紀大的父母。
examples.pinyin: Xiǎo Gāo xīwàng néng zǎorì tuìxiū, huí xiāngxià zhàogù niánjì dà de fùmǔ.
examples.english: Xiao Gao hopes to retire sooner and return to the countryside to take care of his elderly parents.

examples.chinese: 何先生早就習慣了單身生活，一點都不想結婚。
examples.pinyin: Hé xiānsheng zǎo jiù xíguàn le dānshēn shēnghuó, yīdiǎn dōu bù xiǎng jiéhūn.
examples.english: Mr. He has long been accustomed to single life and doesn't want to get married at all.

examples.chinese: 我每天早上一醒來就去刷牙、洗臉，然後去附近國小的操場跑步。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ měitiān zǎoshang yì xǐnglái jiù qù shuāyá, xǐliǎn, ránhòu qù fùjìn guóxiǎo de cāochǎng pǎobù.
examples.english: Every morning as soon as I wake up, I go brush my teeth and wash my face, and then I go running on the playground of the nearby elementary school.

examples.chinese: 我每天睡覺前都會把明天的早餐預備好，這樣一起床只要加熱就能吃了。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ měitiān shuìjiào qián dōu huì bǎ míngtiān de zǎocān yùbèi hǎo, zhèyàng yī qǐchuáng zhǐyào jiārè jiù néng chī le.
examples.english: Every day before going to bed, I prepare tomorrow's breakfast, so that as soon as I get up, I just need to heat it up and can eat.

examples.chinese: 一大早就有不少民眾在寺廟前的廣場上運動。
examples.pinyin: Yī dàzǎo jiù yǒu bùshǎo mínzhòng zài sìmiào qián de guǎngchǎng shàng yùndòng.
examples.english: Early in the morning, quite a few people are already exercising in the square in front of the temple.

examples.chinese: 古小姐做事的態度很積極，為了完成任務，總是很早就做好計畫，而且立刻實行。
examples.pinyin: Gǔ xiǎojiě zuòshì de tàidù hěn jījí, wèile wánchéng rènwù, zǒngshì hěn zǎo jiù zuò hǎo jìhuà, érqiě lìkè shíxíng.
examples.english: Miss Gu has a very proactive attitude toward work. In order to complete tasks, she always makes plans early and immediately carries them out.

examples.chinese: 科學家早就證明了氣溫的變化對農業生產有不好的影響，可是到目前還找不到解決的好辦法。
examples.pinyin: Kēxuéjiā zǎo jiù zhèngmíng le qìwēn de biànhuà duì nóngyè shēngchǎn yǒu bù hǎo de yǐngxiǎng, kěshì dào mùqián hái zhǎo bú dào jiějué de hǎo bànfǎ.
examples.english: Scientists proved long ago that temperature changes have a bad effect on agricultural production, but up to now they still cannot find a good solution.

items.wordHook: a 日(sun) climbs past 十(ten) on the clock → 早(early).

examples.chinese: 這道菜能夠這麼好吃，是因為加了特別的醬料，還有自己做的醬油。
examples.pinyin: Zhè dào cài nénggòu zhème hǎochī, shì yīnwèi jiāle tèbié de jiàngliào, hái yǒu zìjǐ zuò de jiàngyóu.
examples.english: This dish can be so delicious because it has special sauce added, plus homemade soy sauce.

examples.chinese: 出國留學有很多好處，除了學習語言，還有文化交流的機會。
examples.pinyin: Chūguó liúxué yǒu hěn duō hǎochù, chúle xuéxí yǔyán, hái yǒu wénhuà jiāoliú de jīhuì.
examples.english: Studying abroad has many benefits; besides learning a language, there are also opportunities for cultural exchange.

examples.chinese: 台灣的夜市很有特色，除了有各式各樣的小吃，還有不少好玩的遊戲。
examples.pinyin: Táiwān de yèshì hěn yǒu tèsè, chúle yǒu gèshìgèyàng de xiǎochī, hái yǒu bùshǎo hǎowán de yóuxì.
examples.english: Taiwan's night markets are very distinctive; besides having various snacks, there are also quite a few fun games.

examples.chinese: 台灣的周圍都是海，還有不少美麗的海灘。
examples.pinyin: Táiwān de zhōuwéi dōu shì hǎi, hái yǒu bùshǎo měilì de hǎitān.
examples.english: Taiwan is surrounded by sea, and there are also many beautiful beaches.

examples.chinese: 在王小姐的部落格裡，除了有她的旅遊日記，還有在非洲大草原騎馬的相片。
examples.pinyin: Zài Wáng xiǎojiě de bùluògé lǐ, chúle yǒu tā de lǚyóu rìjì, hái yǒu zài Fēizhōu dà cǎoyuán qí mǎ de xiàngpiàn.
examples.english: In Miss Wang's blog, besides her travel diary, there are also photos of horseback riding on the African savanna.

examples.chinese: 臺灣南部不僅天氣好、旅遊景點多，還有各式各樣的傳統小吃，很值得去走走。
examples.pinyin: Táiwān nánbù bùjǐn tiānqì hǎo, lǚyóu jǐngdiǎn duō, hái yǒu gè shì gè yàng de chuántǒng xiǎochī, hěn zhídé qù zǒuzǒu.
examples.english: Southern Taiwan not only has good weather and many touring spots, but also has all kinds of traditional snacks; it's well worth a visit.

examples.chinese: 這棟商業大樓的規模很大，除了有很多商店、餐廳，還有電影院、健身房。
examples.pinyin: Zhè dòng shāngyè dàlóu de guīmó hěn dà, chúle yǒu hěn duō shāngdiàn, cāntīng, hái yǒu diànyǐngyuàn, jiànshēnfáng.
examples.english: The scale of this commercial building is very large; besides many shops and restaurants, there are also a movie theater and a gym.

examples.chinese: 這次期末考的題目很難，大家的成績都不好，還有幾個人被當了。
examples.pinyin: Zhè cì qīmò kǎo de tímù hěn nán, dàjiā de chéngjì dōu bù hǎo, hái yǒu jǐ ge rén bèi dāng le.
examples.english: The questions on this final exam were very difficult; everyone’s grades were bad, and several people even failed the course.

examples.chinese: 我爺爺年紀大了，不但體力不好，還有頭痛、肩膀痛的毛病。我家的洗衣機用了二十多年了，毛病真不少，可是媽媽還不肯換新的。
examples.pinyin: Wǒ yéye niánjì dà le, bùdàn tǐlì bù hǎo, hái yǒu tóutòng, jiānbǎng tòng de máobìng. Wǒ jiā de xǐyījī yòng le èrshí duō nián le, máobìng zhēn bù shǎo, kěshì māma hái bù kěn huàn xīn de.
examples.english: My grandpa is old; not only is his physical strength poor, but he also has the problem of headaches and shoulder pain. Our washing machine has been used for over twenty years and has quite a few problems, but Mom still won't agree to replace it with a new one.

examples.chinese: 這次亞洲文化展，除了樂器表演，還有傳統服裝試穿活動，歡迎各位來參觀。
examples.pinyin: Zhè cì Yàzhōu wénhuà zhǎn, chúle yuèqì biǎoyǎn, hái yǒu chuántǒng fúzhuāng shìchuān huódòng, huānyíng gèwèi lái cānguān.
examples.english: This Asian Culture Exhibition, in addition to musical instrument performances, also has traditional clothing try-on activities; everyone is welcome to visit.

examples.chinese: 去郵局領包裹的時候，記得帶身分證、圖章還有通知單。
examples.pinyin: Qù yóujú lǐng bāoguǒ de shíhou, jìde dài shēnfènzhèng, túzhāng hái yǒu tōngzhīdān.
examples.english: When going to the post office to pick up a parcel, remember to bring your ID card, seal, and notification slip.

examples.chinese: 大自然除了有各種動植物，還有山地、平原、河流等等，這一切應該是上帝創造的。
examples.pinyin: Dàzìrán chúle yǒu gè zhǒng dòngzhíwù, hái yǒu shāndì, píngyuán, héliú děngděng, zhè yíqiè yīnggāi shì Shàngdì chuàngzào de.
examples.english: In addition to having various animals and plants, nature also has mountains, plains, rivers, and so on; all of this was presumably created by God.

examples.chinese: 市場為了改善兒童和青少年的生活品質，而增加了球場、游泳池等休閒場所。
examples.pinyin: Shìchǎng wèile gǎishàn értóng hé qīngshàonián de shēnghuó pǐnzhí, ér zēngjiā le qiúchǎng, yóuyǒngchí děng xiūxián chǎngsuǒ.
examples.english: In order to improve the quality of life for children and teenagers, the market added leisure places such as ball courts and swimming pools.

examples.chinese: 為了避免兒童發生意外，家長在樓梯邊裝了安全網。
examples.pinyin: Wèile bìmiǎn értóng fāshēng yìwài, jiāzhǎng zài lóutī biān zhuāng le ānquán wǎng.
examples.english: To avoid accidents involving children, the parents installed a safety net beside the stairs.

examples.chinese: 只有圖畫，沒有文字的故事書 ，能夠留給兒童想像及思考的空間。
examples.pinyin: Zhǐyǒu túhuà, méiyǒu wénzì de gùshìshū, nénggòu liú gěi értóng xiǎngxiàng jí sīkǎo de kōngjiān.
examples.english: Storybooks with only pictures and no text can leave children room for imagination and thinking.

examples.chinese: 這些跟卡通人物有關書籍，很適合兒童閱讀。
examples.pinyin: Zhèxiē gēn kǎtōng rénwù yǒuguān de shūjí, hěn shìhé értóng yuèdú.
examples.english: These books related to cartoon characters are very suitable for children to read.

items.wordHook: Combining 兒(son) and 童(child): 兒童 means child, children.

examples.chinese: 不少博物館裡的藝術品都是從古代保留到現代的，具有重要的時代意義。
examples.pinyin: Bùshǎo bówùguǎn lǐ de yìshùpǐn dōu shì cóng gǔdài bǎoliú dào xiàndài de, jùyǒu zhòngyào de shídài yìyì.
examples.english: Many artworks in museums have been preserved from ancient times to the present and have important historical significance.

examples.chinese: 博物館內的藝術品價值都很高，不小心弄壞了可是要賠償不少錢的。
examples.pinyin: Bówùguǎn nèi de yìshùpǐn jiàzhí dōu hěn gāo, bù xiǎoxīn nòng huài le kěshì yào péicháng bù shǎo qián de.
examples.english: The artworks in the museum are all very valuable; if you accidentally damage them, you will have to compensate a lot of money.

items.wordHook: A refined creative work displaying 藝(art) and technical 術(skill) crafted as a fine 品(article): 藝術品 means work of art.

examples.chinese: 很濃的茶跟很濃的咖啡一樣，都會讓人睡不著覺。
examples.pinyin: Hěn nóng de chá gēn hěn nóng de kāfēi yīyàng, dōu huì ràng rén shuì bù zháo jiào.
examples.english: Strong tea, like strong coffee, will keep people from sleeping.

examples.chinese: 他沖咖啡的技術很好，香味總是比別人沖的濃。
examples.pinyin: Tā chōng kāfēi de jìshù hěn hǎo, xiāngwèi zǒngshì bǐ biérén chōng de nóng.
examples.english: His coffee-brewing technique is very good; the aroma is always stronger than that of coffee brewed by others.

examples.chinese: 他沖咖啡的技術很好，香味總是比別人沖的濃。
examples.pinyin: Tā chōng kāfēi de jìshù hěn hǎo, xiāngwèi zǒngshì bǐ biérén chōng de nóng.
examples.english: His coffee-brewing technique is very good; the aroma is always stronger than that of coffee brewed by others.

items.wordHook: Rich brown 土(soil) is packed into a hollow pit until it is 真(real) solid: 填(fill).
an 封(envelope) of 帛(silk) holds a gift → a hand of 幫(help).
母(mother) + 親(close relative) → your closest relative: 母親(mother).
八(eight) sparks rest around a 人(person) → the blaze of 火(fire).
Needing to 還(also) take an additional 要(essential) item: 還要 means even more.
